title: Tanay, Sneha Upset Seeds, Reach Third Round at Junior Nationals
indian_angle: Young Indian talents Tanay and Sneha have shown promising form by upsetting seeded players in a significant national tournament.
summary: Tanay and Sneha delivered strong performances at the ongoing Junior Badminton Nationals, successfully navigating past seeded opponents to secure their spots in the third round.

title: 88th Senior National Badminton Championships Set for Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: India's top senior badminton players will compete for national honors at this prestigious event, a key fixture in the domestic calendar.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced that the 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships will be held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17th to 24th, 2026.

title: Badminton Association of India Elections to be Held in Guwahati
indian_angle: The upcoming elections will determine the leadership of the Badminton Association of India, influencing the future direction of the sport in the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has scheduled its forthcoming elections for December 26, 2026, which will take place in Guwahati, defining the next leadership for Indian badminton.

title: 49th Junior National Badminton Championships Kicks Off in Sikkim
indian_angle: This national event is crucial for identifying and nurturing the next generation of Indian badminton stars.
summary: The 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026, featuring India's promising young talent, is currently being held in Sikkim from November 14th to 21st.

title: Indian Juniors Prepare at National Camp for World Championships
indian_angle: India's top junior players are undergoing intensive training to represent the nation at the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing the Indian contingent for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
